title: BMI Calculator
seoTitle: Free BMI Calculator — Calculate Body Mass Index Online
description: Calculate your Body Mass Index (BMI) from weight and height in metric or imperial units. See category and healthy range. Private browser calculation.
intro: Enter your weight and height. Choose metric (kg, cm) or imperial (lb, in). Instantly see your BMI and weight category.
blurb: Calculate BMI from weight and height with metric or imperial units.
howItWorks: Enter weight and select unit (kg or lb).
Enter height and select unit (cm or in).
BMI updates live as you type. Categories follow standard WHO ranges.
examples: 70 kg and 175 cm gives a BMI of about 22.9 (Normal).
160 lb and 68 in gives a BMI of about 24.3 (Normal).
Use to track fitness goals or check healthy weight ranges.

faq.a: No. The calculation runs entirely in your browser.
BMI is a useful screening tool but does not account for muscle mass, age, or body composition.
